# UE6 vs Unity7 知识图谱

## 图1：引擎属性总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    UE6["Unreal Engine 6"] -->|免费| CommonFree["免费"]
    Unity7["Unity 7"] -->|免费| CommonFree
    UE6 -->|3D表现优秀| Common3D["3D表现优秀"]
    Unity7 -->|3D表现优秀| Common3D
    UE6 -->|华丽图形与动画功能| UEFeat1["华丽图形与动画"]
    UE6 -->|Lumen 动态全局光照| UEFeat2["Lumen 动态全局光照"]
    UE6 -->|NIAGARA 粒子系统| UEFeat3["NIAGARA 粒子系统"]
    UE6 -->|MetaHuman 系列| UEFeat4["MetaHuman 系列"]
    UE6 -->|AI 集成 (MCP模型) | UEFeat5["AI 集成 (MCP模型)"]
    Unity7 -->|统一渲染管线 (URP) | UnityFeat1["统一渲染管线 (URP)"]
    Unity7 -->|Surface Cache GI (全局光照) | UnityFeat2["Surface Cache GI"]
    Unity7 -->|VFX Graph (无需编码) | UnityFeat3["VFX Graph"]
    Unity7 -->|2D 多线程物理核心包 | UnityFeat4["2D 多线程物理核心包"]
    Unity7 -->|NEURO 纹理压缩 (内存/大小减半) | UnityFeat5["NEURO 纹理压缩"]
    Unity7 -->|AI 场景设置 (Busy) | UnityFeat6["AI 场景设置 (Busy)"]
```

## 图2：选择引擎的决策路径
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start["开发需求"] --> NeedHighEnd["需要高端写实渲染或电影级动画？"]
    NeedHighEnd -->|是| ChooseUE["选择 Unreal Engine 6"]
    NeedHighEnd -->|否| Need2D["主要开发 2D / 移动游戏？"]
    Need2D -->|是| ChooseUnity["选择 Unity 7"]
    Need2D -->|否| NeedMultiplayer["需要大规模多人在线 (MMO)？"]
    NeedMultiplayer -->|是| UEorUnity["UE6 与 Unity7 均支持多人，比较预算"]
    UEorUnity --> Budget["预算限制？"]
    Budget -->|低| ChooseUnity
    Budget -->|高| ChooseUE
    ChooseUE --> ReasonUE["UE6 提供 Lumen、NIAGARA、MetaHuman、强大破坏系统"]
    ChooseUnity --> ReasonUnity["Unity7 提供 URP、Surface Cache GI、2D 物理、NEURO 压缩、免费起步"]
```

## 图3：渲染管线与光照系统比较
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UE6 --> Lumen["Lumen 动态全局光照"]
    UE6 --> SurfaceCache["Surface Cache GI (实时动态光照)"]
    UE6 --> NIAGARA["NIAGARA 粒子系统"]
    Lumen -->|支持光线追踪| RT["光线追踪 (性能极限)"]
    Lumen -->|需要高端硬件| HWReq["硬件要求高"]
    SurfaceCache -->|可能比 Lumen 性能更好| PerfBetter["性能更好"]
    Unity7 --> URP["统一渲染管线 (URP)"]
    Unity7 --> SurfaceCacheU["Surface Cache GI (全局光照)"]
    Unity7 --> VFXGraph["VFX Graph (无需编码)"]
    URP -->|流程更简洁| Simpler["流程更简洁"]
    SurfaceCacheU -->|适合中等硬件| MidHW["中等硬件"]
```
